page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-64 is an Arm64-based virtual machine instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core, positioning it within the memory-optimized category. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options.

Operating on an Arm64 architecture, this server type offers a high-density resource profile designed for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of x86 instruction sets. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the Arm-based architecture typically delivers a favorable balance of high memory capacity and compute density relative to resource costs, making it suitable for scaling memory-bound applications efficiently.

The n4a-highmem-64 is engineered for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from a high memory-to-CPU ratio. Suitable use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics pipelines, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy development or build environments.
